_comment: Unified five-approach one-month SPY/TLT experiment. Three active LLM/quant models and Static benchmark. Causal RAG requires new SPY/TLT monthly agent records; no proxy or three-asset forecasts are accepted. Common Omega comes from DET expanding past-only validation errors.

sources.macro_panel: stage2 run spec dev v4 (8 macro surprises)

_covariance_note: sample = plain 36-month sample covariance (ddof=1). With two assets Ledoit-Wolf shrinks 40-100% toward equal variances and zero correlation, which erases the SPY-TLT negative correlation; 'ledoit_wolf' is kept as an option.
